_docs.overview: Star classes for system generation. Each seed picks a star class via weighted random selection, then applies per-instance variation from the defaults ranges.
_docs.class_selection: classWeights array controls probability: [O, B, A, F, G, K, M]. Sum of weights = total probability pool. Same seed always picks the same class.

field_reference.color: #RRGGBB — Star surface color. O/B stars are blue-white, G stars are yellow-white, K/M are orange-red.
field_reference.brightness: float — Light intensity multiplier. Combined with per-instance brightnessRange variation.
field_reference.radius: float — Light reach distance. Combined with per-instance radiusRange variation.
field_reference.classWeights: [O, B, A, F, G, K, M] — Relative probability weights for each class. Higher = more common.
field_reference.brightnessRange: [min, max] — Per-instance brightness variation. Base brightness * random(min, max).
field_reference.radiusRange: [min, max] — Per-instance radius variation. Base radius * random(min, max).
field_reference.starFieldRange: [min, max] — Number of background stars per system. Random value between min and max per system.

tips.more_red_stars: Increase M class weight, decrease O/B weights
tips.dimmer_universe: Lower all brightness values or widen brightnessRange downward
tips.bigger_lights: Increase radius values on desired classes
